desc_en: New art from Ars Electronica 2026, the Whitney Biennial and the Lumen Prize; research on machine emotion, model welfare, chatbot endings and agent societies; films, performances and installations from East and Southeast Asia; Global South and Indigenous practices; speculative design; and works added from the open leads.
desc_zh: 来自 2026 年林茨电子艺术节、惠特尼双年展与 Lumen Prize 的新作；关于机器情绪、模型福利、聊天机器人的终结与智能体社会的研究；东亚与东南亚的电影、表演与装置；全球南方与原住民实践；思辨设计；以及从待查线索中补入的作品。

desc_en: Art and research from 2025–26, with a focus on Asia, the Global South and design, plus works added from the open leads.
desc_zh: 2025–26 年的艺术与研究，侧重亚洲、全球南方与设计，另有从待查线索中补入的作品。

en: AI consciousness, suffering and shutdown resistance
zh: AI 意识、痛苦与抗拒关机
desc_en: Research, theory and artworks on whether machines can be conscious, whether they can suffer, and what happens when they resist being switched off.
desc_zh: 关于机器是否可能有意识、是否会痛苦，以及它们抗拒被关机时会发生什么的研究、理论与艺术作品。

desc_en: Art, papers and books from 2024–26, and works added from the open leads.
desc_zh: 2024–26 年的艺术作品、论文与书籍，以及从待查线索中补入的作品。
